checklist.description: CRITICAL boundary validation: Data received at boundary edge EDGE-EXTERNAL-HISTORY-DATA must be validated for correct format and type before processing.

Falsification test: The ambiguity 'Mainnet activation is described as 'shortly (a few days or weeks) after' Pectra activation without a precise timeline.' must be resolved deterministically: all implementations must adopt an identical interpretation.

Falsification test: The assumption 'Data retrieved from alternate sources can be trusted to be authentic if it validates against known block hashes.' must hold. Violation may lead to consensus failure or security degradation.
Falsification test: Data retrieved from alternate sources (e2store, Portal Network) must be validated against known block hashes before being served.

Falsification test: The ambiguity 'The proposal states gas is charged 'only for memory that is actually written to' but the formula charges for output_start + min(output_size, n), which may include unwritten bytes if output_start > current MSIZE.' must be resolved deterministically: all implementations must adopt an identical interpretation.

Falsification test: The assumption 'Objects stored in memory after CALL operations must be relocatable since absolute positions may change based on actual return data size.' must hold. Violation may lead to consensus failure or security degradation.
CRITICAL boundary validation: Data received at boundary edge EDGE-RECEIVE-TX must be validated for correct format and type before processing.
CRITICAL boundary validation: Data received at boundary edge EDGE-AUTH-REPLAY-ATTEMPT must be validated for correct format and type before processing.

Falsification test: The ambiguity 'No specification for how delegation indicator interacts with CREATE/CREATE2 opcodes if executed in delegated context.' must be resolved deterministically: all implementations must adopt an identical interpretation.

Falsification test: The assumption 'Existing contracts relying on msg.sender == tx.origin for EOA detection will have that invariant broken.' must hold. Violation may lead to consensus failure or security degradation.
Falsification test: Authorization tuples in EIP-7702 transactions must contain valid ECDSA signatures from the delegating EOA.
Falsification test: The chain_id in the authorization tuple must match the current chain or be 0 (wildcard) for cross-chain authorization.
Falsification test: The assumption 'All client implementations will adopt consensus layer changes uniformly.' must hold. Violation may lead to consensus failure or security degradation.
CRITICAL boundary validation: Inputs crossing trust boundary at EDGE-PEER-BLOCK-FORK must not exceed expected size limits to prevent resource exhaustion.
Falsification test: The assumption 'All nodes have accurate knowledge of past and upcoming fork block numbers.' must hold. Violation may lead to consensus failure or security degradation.
Falsification test: After a successful eth/64 handshake, both peers must be on compatible fork configurations.

Falsification test: The ambiguity 'Block >= 0 on future testnets is vague about which testnets this applies to.' must be resolved deterministically: all implementations must adopt an identical interpretation.
Falsification test: After the Homestead activation block, all Homestead consensus rules must be enforced for every subsequent block.

Falsification test: The ambiguity 'The exact definition of 'exceptional failure' is referenced but not defined' must be resolved deterministically: all implementations must adopt an identical interpretation.
Falsification test: The immediate operand for extended stack access opcodes must reference a valid stack position (within current stack depth).
CRITICAL boundary validation: Inputs crossing trust boundary at EDGE-RECEIVE-TX must not exceed expected size limits to prevent resource exhaustion.

Falsification test: The ambiguity 'Handling of recursive struct types with circular references is not explicitly addressed.' must be resolved deterministically: all implementations must adopt an identical interpretation.
Falsification test: The assumption 'Verifying contracts correctly implement the EIP-712 encoding and hashing algorithm.' must hold. Violation may lead to consensus failure or security degradation.
Falsification test: Wallets must display the full typed data structure to users before signing—no fields may be hidden or obfuscated.
CRITICAL boundary validation: Inputs crossing trust boundary at EDGE-RECEIVE-ATTESTATION must not exceed expected size limits to prevent resource exhaustion.

Falsification test: The ambiguity 'The term 'compounding withdrawal credentials' is referenced without a full definition of which credential prefixes qualify.' must be resolved deterministically: all implementations must adopt an identical interpretation.
Falsification test: During the Electra fork transition, pending deposit entries must preserve their original ordering from the deposit queue.
CRITICAL boundary validation: Inputs crossing trust boundary at EDGE-RECEIVE-TX must not exceed expected size limits to prevent resource exhaustion.

Falsification test: The assumption 'All client implementations track touched accounts consistently during transaction execution.' must hold. Violation may lead to consensus failure or security degradation.
Falsification test: No account may transition from non-existent to existent-but-empty (zero nonce, zero balance, no code).
CRITICAL boundary validation: Inputs crossing trust boundary at EDGE-EL-PAYLOAD-VALIDATION must be checked for cryptographic validity where applicable.
Falsification test: BLS withdrawal keys used for credential changes must not be derivable from validator signing keys.

Falsification test: The assumption 'All nodes will eventually upgrade to Electra and the network format for pre-fork data will remain available during the transition period' must hold. Violation may lead to consensus failure or security degradation.
CRITICAL boundary validation: Data received at boundary edge EDGE-PEER-BLOCK-FORK must be validated for correct format and type before processing.

Falsification test: The ambiguity 'No specification for how sequence numbers should increment or what constitutes a 'newer' record beyond simple comparison' must be resolved deterministically: all implementations must adopt an identical interpretation.
Falsification test: The assumption 'Nodes properly increment sequence numbers when updating their ENR' must hold. Violation may lead to consensus failure or security degradation.
Falsification test: An attacker must not be able to forge or modify ENR records without the node's private key.

Falsification test: The assumption 'The Fulu fork has been successfully activated before EIP-7805, as this fork upgrades from Fulu state.' must hold. Violation may lead to consensus failure or security degradation.
CRITICAL boundary validation: Inputs crossing trust boundary at EDGE-BLOCK-PROPOSER-INCLUSION must be checked for cryptographic validity where applicable.
Falsification test: The assumption 'Network conditions are stable enough that a static configuration is effective' must hold. Violation may lead to consensus failure or security degradation.
Falsification test: After applying the blob limit, the total blob gas in the constructed block must not exceed MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK.
CRITICAL boundary validation: Inputs crossing trust boundary at EDGE-RECEIVE-TX must be checked for cryptographic validity where applicable.

Falsification test: The assumption 'The accessed_storage_keys set is assumed to be correctly maintained across all message frames' must hold. Violation may lead to consensus failure or security degradation.
Falsification test: Transient storage (TLOAD/TSTORE) must be completely cleared at the end of each transaction—no data persists across transactions.
Falsification test: Before CALL-like operations, the gas remaining must exceed GAS_CALL_STIPEND to prevent reentrancy via gas manipulation.
